reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 000065 (the melody read from 000065a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, 1 note off in 20); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. Edward John Hopkins's dates (1818–1901) are from our page for the tune KELSO (content/hymns/tunes/kelso.json); CCEH's page gives only the year 1869. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (000065a.nwc). The tune ends on Eb, neither doh nor lah: it may be modal; the doh is the key signature's.
